related_resources.reason: Original 1979 introduction of the bootstrap and sampling-distribution approximation.
Bootstrap replicate construction and percentile confidence intervals.
Sampling coverage and the construction of intervals.

historical_claims.anchor: The bootstrap was introduced by Bradley Efron in 1979 as a broadly reusable way to estimate sampling distributions through computation.

authorship.scope: Original statistical-inference foundation lecture and non-spoken mathematical companion; earlier manuscripts preserved.

prerequisites.reason: Elementary probability and estimation material from 017000.
Elementary probability and estimation material from 021000.

background: Elementary probability, fractions, logarithms and basic calculus. No measure theory, asymptotic statistics or Bayesian analysis required.
readiness_checks: Calculate a bootstrap standard error for a four-observation mean exactly.
Explain the distinction between bootstrap replicates and independent new experimental data.
Diagnose failure of naive bootstrap for all-success Bernoulli data and dependent observations.
